notes: Swappable ingredients: a variant choice can now declare which recipe ingredient it replaces — selecting Oat Milk deducts oat milk and skips the recipe's condensed/full milk line, online and offline. Works for reusable variant choices and product options, with a 'replaces recipe ingredient' picker in both editors. Variant library edits now reach attached products — choice edits, new choices, and group renames cascade automatically while per-product Required stays local. Product details: add-ons are managed exclusively through attached variant groups (manual entry removed); the attach picker is also in the ADD-ONS section. Requires the replaces_ingredient_id migration (already applied).
